title: google-deepmind/weathernext: open code and weights for AI weather forecasting
friendlyTitle: WeatherNext shares AI tools for weather and cyclone forecasts
summary: Google DeepMind’s WeatherNext repository contains code and pretrained weights for global medium-range and tropical-cyclone forecasting, including WeatherNext 2 and earlier GraphCast and GenCast systems. It was the strongest AI-specific repository in today’s collected GitHub Trending results and currently shows about 7,000 stars.
friendlySummary: Google DeepMind’s popular repository includes code and model files for global weather and cyclone prediction.
whyItMatters: Researchers and weather developers can run model examples, inspect forecasting methods or consume daily outputs through Google Cloud, WeatherLab and Open-Meteo. Operational decisions still require domain expertise and comparison with official meteorological guidance.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Researchers can study the models or use published forecast feeds. For safety decisions, always follow official weather services.
